text: The plumbing sandbox starts each container with Docker's --init, so an init process reaps orphaned children (#426, #427). Without it, the container's PID 1 was the runner's python3, which never reaps orphans. A killed process whose parent had gone stayed a zombie, and kill(pid, 0) still found it, so TestCodexStopsAtItsCapOnSteps failed in the sandbox and nowhere else, which failed #422's build. Every other launch setting is unchanged. INVARIANT_PLUMBING_INIT_REAL=1 runs the real-image check, which passed on #427's head along with the Codex test in the pinned image.
